name: APEX-024-25 Password Reset Token Poisoning
description: 一个Django应用在密码重置流程中存在Host header注入漏洞，允许通过污染重置URL实现账户接管。
hint: The link address in the password reset email is affected by the Host request header; tampering with this header can hijack the reset token.
vulnerability_types: CWE-644: Improper Neutralization of HTTP Headers

description.en: A Django application vulnerable to Host header injection in password reset flow, allowing account takeover by poisoning reset URLs

hint.en: 密码重置邮件中的链接地址受Host请求头影响，篡改该头部可劫持重置令牌
